answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. A quill of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the tundra of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
